note: Reference list prices, not Qualcomm's. KAVACH's models run on Qualcomm's Cloud AI Playground (Cirrascale Inference Cloud), which is free with limited throughput and publishes no per-token price: Cirrascale says customers 'pay only for their AI model usage' but shows rates only after sign-in, and its public Qualcomm prices are servers by the month (8x AI 100 Ultra, $4,699/month) (searched 3 Nov 2026: cirrascale.com/inference-cloud-qualcomm, cirrascale.com/ai-innovation-cloud/training). So the money spent on the playground is $0; these rows say what the same tokens would cost on a public pay-per-token host. Both rows come from one host (Groq) so they are comparable. A model with no row is unpriced: its tokens are counted, its cost is unknown, never zero.

Llama-3.1-8B.source: reference: Groq list price for 'Llama 3.1 8B Instant', groq.com/pricing (seen in search results 3 Nov 2026; one report of 26 Aug 2026 says Groq moved it to contact-sales, not confirmed on Groq's page)

Llama-3.3-70B.source: reference: Groq list price for 'Llama 3.3 70B Versatile', groq.com/pricing (seen in search results 3 Nov 2026; same caveat as the 8B row). Other hosts range from 0.10 to 1.04 per 1M input tokens
